scope: Native measurement implementation and non-cryptographic development controls; root-library validation remains incomplete.
statement: The native cubic measurement continuation adds process-resident C++/Rust hooks and a standalone runner reusing ecbench grading. Its unsigned receipts report 77 library tests and one lifecycle integration test passing, both actual solver entry points building, unchanged grading bytes, and the real C++ driver retaining its expected invalid-argument failure as L0. This is development evidence, not ECDLP benchmark or execution verification.
